about: AUTHORED merchant roster for docs/NPC_TRADERS.md §3.2. scripts/build-npc-0098.mjs reads this file, measures every candidate loop on the applied chain through the ONE executor, chooses each fleet's loop (the runner-up becomes its alternate), trims hulls by the steady-state rule, sizes capital, writes the blurbs from the measured lines, and emits supabase/migrations/20260818000098_the_merchant_companies_are_founded.sql plus data/npc-routes.generated.json. Loops are space-separated harbour codes, stop 0 = home; the FIRST loop listed is the one the 2026-10-08 measurement chose. officers = specialties wanted (picked from the catalogue by home port on the loop, then nation, then bonus). skills = SEAMANSHIP/NAVIGATION/ACCOUNTING/HAGGLING levels. ink = the nation family the map paints the hull in. wares = the goods the planner prefers (it falls back to any paying good only when none of these pays).
